class.name: PhysXBlastFractureTask
class.brief_description: A Blast fracture running in the background.
class.description: Returned by [method PhysXBlastAuthoring.fracture_mesh_async]. The fracture goes through six stages (see [method get_stage]); the task reports each one as it starts, and finishes with the asset. Its signals are emitted on the main thread. Blast can't stop partway through a stage, so how far along a stage is can't be known, and [method cancel] takes effect when the running stage ends. For a detailed mesh, cleaning it up (stage 2) takes most of the time.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Stops the fracture once the stage it's on ends (at once, between hulls): [signal finished] is then emitted with [code]null[/code], and [method is_cancelled] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: get_asset
method.description: The fractured asset once finished, the same one [signal finished] gave; [code]null[/code] while running, on failure, or if cancelled.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Why the fracture failed, once finished: the same text [method PhysXBlastAuthoring.get_last_error] gives for [method PhysXBlastAuthoring.fracture_mesh], or [code]"Cancelled."[/code]. Empty if it succeeded.

method.name: get_last_warnings
method.description: What the fracture warned about, once finished, as [method PhysXBlastAuthoring.get_last_warnings].

method.name: get_stage
method.description: The stage it's on, from [code]1[/code] to [method get_stage_count]; [code]0[/code] before the first starts. In order: checking the mesh, cleaning it up, fracturing, finalizing the pieces, building bonds and collision, cooking the pieces' collision hulls.

method.name: get_stage_description
method.description: The stage it's on, as [signal stage_changed] last described it (for example [code]"Cooking collision hulls (12 of 64)"[/code]).

method.name: is_cancelled
method.description: Whether it finished because [method cancel] stopped it.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Whether it hasn't finished yet: [code]false[/code] once [signal finished] is emitted.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted once, when the fracture ends: with the asset, or [code]null[/code] if it failed or was cancelled (see [method get_last_error]).

signal.name: stage_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a stage starts, and again for each piece while their collision hulls are cooked. [param description] names the stage, for example [code]"Cleaning up the mesh"[/code] or [code]"Cooking collision hulls (12 of 64)"[/code].
